name: Fair Duelist - Customizable Difficulty
summary: Customize enemy health, damage, stamina costs and attack delays with absolute percentages. Start from the game's selected difficulty, then edit settings.ini or use the optional Mod Setting Menu. Requires UE4SS.
author: oOCamilleOo

file.description: Customize absolute difficulty percentages with optional Mod Setting Menu controls or manual settings.ini editing. Includes native difficulty synchronization and save-load recovery.

changelog: Add optional Mod Setting Menu controls alongside manual settings.ini editing.
Use absolute percentages for enemy health, damage, stamina costs and three attack-delay controls, with 0% to 500% ranges and 5-point menu steps.
Add a separate option for attacks while another enemy blocks.
Load standard balance values when a difficulty is confirmed in the game settings; preserve custom balance when a preview is canceled.
Keep the original game difficulty names and remove cooked difficulty replacements and shared menu overrides.
Restore custom balance after save loads with missed loading notifications or delayed player initialization.
Reset obsolete or invalid settings to current defaults and simplify diagnostics to one Logging switch.

requirements.name: UE4SS for BoD
requirements.notes: Required for all balance changes; use a build compatible with your game.

requirements.name: Mod Setting Menu
requirements.notes: Optional in-game settings UI. You can edit FairDuelist/settings.ini without it.
